To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ICR of an uncompacted Rutherford cable is independent of the width of the SS core.
the ICR of a cable depends on its compaction state, and that, in the uncompacted state, the ICR is independent of core width.
the ICRs of tightly compacted HQ cables are a function of the widths of their SS cores, whereas those of uncompacted QXF cables are independent of the widths.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interplay of the ICR and the cable compaction.

the interstrand contact resistivity in high-gradient quadrupole Nb 3 Sn Rutherford cables and its variation as a function of the position and width of stainless-steel cores and of the reaction-heat-treat (RHT) pressure condition.
the interstrand coupling properties of LARP high gradient quadrupoles (HQ) and QXF cables in response to variations in cable design and heat treatment condition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
interstrand coupling in Nb3Sn cable-in-conduit superconducting magnets is not a function of the width or position of the stainless-steel core.
the HQ and QXF cable types have very different interstrand coupling properties.
the interstrand coupling properties of the Nb3Sn RHT cables depend on the cable design and RHT conditions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the HQ and QXF cables are both suitable for the LHC upgrade, but the HQ cables have a more robust ICR performance.
the ICRs of cored cables can be predicted from the ICRs and the core widths of uncored cables.
the HQ cables were tightly wound such that the SS core width was the dominant parameter affecting ICR.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the interstrand coupling properties of a cable are strongly dependent on the cable design and heat treatment condition.
the ICRs in cored Nb3Sn RHT Rutherford cables can vary with the RHT condition, cable design, and cable compaction.
, when designing Nb3Sn RHT cored cable, it is important to ensure the absence of any pseudocore.
